title: Migrate token storage from Postgres to Redis
author: Sarah Chen
description: Moves all token persistence from Postgres to Redis for sub-millisecond lookups. Includes migration script and rollback plan.

title: Add OAuth 2.0 PKCE flow for mobile clients
author: Sarah Chen
description: Implements PKCE extension for OAuth 2.0 authorization code flow to support native mobile clients securely.

title: Implement SAML SSO for enterprise clients
author: Sarah Chen
description: Full SAML 2.0 SSO implementation supporting IdP-initiated and SP-initiated flows for enterprise tier customers.

title: Platform API rate limiting middleware
author: Mike Rodriguez
description: Adds sliding-window rate limiting with per-tenant configurable thresholds and Redis-backed counters.

title: Kubernetes cluster autoscaler configuration
author: Alex Kim
description: Configures cluster autoscaler with proper PDB settings and node group scaling policies for production workloads.

title: Add Stripe webhook signature verification
author: Priya Patel
description: Implements Stripe webhook signature verification with replay attack prevention and idempotent event processing.

title: Token refresh rotation with grace period
author: Sarah Chen
description: Implements refresh token rotation with configurable grace period to prevent token reuse while handling concurrent requests gracefully.

title: Admin dashboard user management table
author: Jordan Taylor
description: Implements sortable, filterable user management table with pagination and bulk action support.

title: CI/CD pipeline for auth-service with security scanning
author: Alex Kim
description: Adds CI pipeline with SAST scanning, dependency audit, and automated container image builds for auth-service.

title: Session invalidation across distributed nodes
author: Sarah Chen
description: Implements cross-node session invalidation using Redis pub/sub to ensure immediate logout propagation across all service instances.
